description.value: North Arm Farm is a family-run working farm on the Sea-to-Sky Highway just outside Pemberton, operating a farm shop stocked with seasonal vegetables, Okanagan fruit, house-made soups, meat pies, and their famous hot sauce. In season (roughly June through October) cyclists can also U-Pick strawberries, blueberries, and pumpkins straight from the fields. It is a distinctive and practical resupply stop for anyone riding the Sea-to-Sky corridor between Whistler and Pemberton.
